difficulty_reason: The author turns size-indexed fixed-point constructions into initial algebras and terminal coalgebras using parametric existential/universal quantifiers. The specialized work defines lifted algebra/coalgebra functors and their adjunctions, establishes weak commutation for arbitrary polynomial functors including infinitely branching ones, and provides the large-size theory with its impredicative realizability context. This is one uniform (co)inductive construction result, with all specialized continuations retained; fixed-point and adjunction lemmas are not counted separately.
